title: Aurora, trained three times with PCC-RL's code, exported for agent_rate and checked against PCC-RL's code
description: The three Auroras trained by experiments/aurora-train.json (releases exp-aurora-train-199, -200 and -201, as t0, t1 and t2; PCC-RL's training is not seeded, so each run gives another model), exported by experiments/aurora_export.py for an agent_rate agent: PCC-RL's three features from agent_rate's monitor-interval statistics, its 10-interval history, the policy's mean and its rate factor 1 + 0.025 a (or 1 / (1 - 0.025 a)). experiments/aurora_weights.py runs PCC-RL's own sender_obs.py and loaded_agent.py (64bea6e) on each SavedModel over 600 synthetic monitor intervals, and each export is checked against it step by step (aurora/check.txt). aurora/aurora-I.onnx is model I as trained; aurora/aurora-blind-I.onnx is the same policy fed the RTT samples PCC-Uspace's deployment gives it (the first and last only, truncated to whole seconds, so 0 below 1 s). Run either as NAME=PATH@rate. aurora/probe-I.txt gives model I's action when its whole history is one interval repeated (the latency ratio it settles at, the random loss it stops growing at). aurora/training.txt gives each run's episodes and its last moving average of the episode reward, from its training log. Later experiments take this release as an input.
run: T=$(mktemp -d); git clone --quiet https://github.com/PCCproject/PCC-RL.git "$T/pcc"; git -C "$T/pcc" checkout --quiet 64bea6eeee3a3e558449c35b6496cf596f5ded52; uv venv --quiet --python 3.8 "$T/tf"; uv pip install --quiet --python "$T/tf/bin/python" tensorflow-cpu==2.4.1 numpy==1.19.5 protobuf==3.20.3; A="$OUT/aurora"; mkdir -p "$A"; uv run python experiments/aurora_export.py stream "$A/stream.npz"; for i in 0 1 2; do R="$IN/t$i/aurora"; (cd "$R" && sha256sum -c --quiet SHA256SUMS); echo "t$i: $(grep -c "Ewma Reward" "$R/train.log") episodes, last $(grep "Ewma Reward" "$R/train.log" | tail -1)" | tee -a "$A/training.txt"; mkdir -p "$A/ref-$i"; cp "$A/stream.npz" "$A/ref-$i/"; "$T/tf/bin/python" -I experiments/aurora_weights.py "$T/pcc" "$R/model" "$A/ref-$i/stream.npz" "$A/ref-$i"; echo "model $i" >> "$A/check.txt"; uv run python experiments/aurora_export.py export "$A/ref-$i" "$A/aurora-$i.onnx" | tee -a "$A/check.txt"; uv run python experiments/aurora_export.py export "$A/ref-$i" "$A/aurora-blind-$i.onnx" --blind | tee -a "$A/check.txt"; uv run python experiments/aurora_export.py probe "$A/ref-$i" | tee "$A/probe-$i.txt"; done; cp "$IN/t0/aurora/LICENSE-pcc-rl.txt" "$A/"; (cd "$A" && sha256sum -- *.onnx check.txt training.txt probe-*.txt LICENSE-pcc-rl.txt stream.npz ref-*/*.npz ref-*/*.npy > SHA256SUMS)
